equipment.source: snapshots/v2/README.md: conceptual apparatus BOM midpoint only; installation and bench excluded, no procurement quote

limitations: Source video and annotation are not reviewed; alternative architectures are proposed concepts.
Every alternative targets the same released-coil geometry/material/function; actual acceptance targets and equivalence remain unresolved.
No investment recommendation can be made from unverified acceptance or hypothetical inputs.
Preparation ranges and winding-only estimates are not summed or transferred into these full-boundary options.
No yield/waste advantage is assumed for automation; shared hypothetical counts and stock are used to isolate labor/capital/energy effects.

warnings: Completeness applies only to the declared boundary; capital investment and payback are not evaluated.
Output acceptance/equivalence is unverified; results are conditional and not ready for a validated comparison.
Known cost subtotal is partial and is not the total cost or necessarily a lower bound.
